UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile data linked to Firebase Authentication and Google Account

id.description: The user's unique Firebase Auth UID

email.description: The Google email address of the user

username.description: Unique username handle for the user

avatarColor.description: Hex color code for user avatar accent

systemPrompt.description: Custom system instructions for Luna AI persona

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's latest sign-in

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A conversation session belonging to an authenticated user

id.description: Unique ID of the chat conversation session

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the chat owner

title.description: Title or summary of the chat

model.description: AI model variant used (standard, coder, pro)

pinned.description: Whether the chat is pinned to top of list

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual message within a chat conversation session

chatId.description: ID of the parent chat conversation

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns the chat

model.description: Model used to generate the message if assistant

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles keyed by their Firebase Auth UID

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores conversation sessions owned by the authenticated user

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Stores messages within a specific conversation session
